lines.text: Without love, tongues make one a clanging cymbal, and prophecy and faith to move the sea make one nothing.
The three things that remain are faith, hope and joy.

problems.problem: Its wrong detail "a mulberry tree" isn't found anywhere in the Bible.
Its wrong detail "hope" is in 1 Corinthians 13:13, so it isn't wrong.
The line also says the true detail "love".
